title: How Tamil People Celebrate Festivals in Singapore
framework: SCALE: Subject, Composition, Action, Location, Aesthetic
usage: Select one image_prompts object and generate one image at a time. Pongal, Vinayagar Chathurthi and Christmas are distinct scenes; do not combine their decorations or rituals. Christmas is included as a festival celebrated by some Tamil Christian families, not as a uniquely Tamil festival.

image_prompts.title: Pongal Cooking in an Apartment
image_prompts.S_subject: A fictional multigenerational Tamil family: father Arun, 35, short black hair, cream cotton shirt and white veshti; mother Meena, 33, braided black hair, maroon saree with a subtle gold border; daughter Kavya, 9, braided hair and mustard-yellow festive dress; grandmother Lakshmi, 65, grey hair in a bun and green cotton saree. Preserve their faces, ages, clothing and body proportions in all Pongal scenes.
image_prompts.C_composition: Wide eye-level view with the family in the foreground, festival decorations in the middle ground, and a recognizable modern Singapore apartment setting in the background.
image_prompts.A_action: The same family gathers around a spacious kitchen area while Meena stirs Pongal on a regular kitchen stove; adults supervise and the child stands away from the stove.
image_prompts.E_aesthetic: Photorealistic respectful family documentary, Warm morning light, realistic people and comfortable festive atmosphere.
constraints: Show one illustrative family, not a universal portrayal of all Tamil residents.
Keep modern Singapore architecture; avoid a rural Tamil Nadu landscape.
Keep anatomy, food, utensils and decorations realistic.
No invented readable signs, logos or watermarks.
Cook only on the regular kitchen stove; keep the child away from heat.
